verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official, well-documented Drive REST API (v3 reference, upload, permissions, push notifications and OAuth guides) plus a machine-readable discovery document, which can support building against Google's interfaces. It also mentions building an AI agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI Agent Engine. However, no evidence names or documents official language SDKs or client libraries for Drive itself, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. missing for 10: explicit evidence of official Drive client libraries/SDKs per language, SDK docs or install guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
